assets.name: sente
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: meeshogi "Seiji" blank shogi piece body, sente side.
Edit target is the attached blank wooden shogi piece.
Change ONLY its material to elegant opaque celadon porcelain in a fresh LIGHT PALE BLUE-GREEN JADE hue. Preserve the exact upright pentagonal silhouette, proportions, centered framing, perfectly straight overhead orthographic view, thin delicate bevel, soft upper-left lighting, shallow edge depth, and transparent alpha background. The face remains completely blank with no letters or symbols.
Replace ALL wood and wood grain with clean opaque porcelain, a refined satin glaze sheen, very subtle microscopic glaze texture. Fresh clear pale blue-green color, bright and luminous enough for black and vermilion lettering that will be added later. Smooth consistent tone across the face with natural restrained highlights at the slender rim.
Avoid gray, muddy or desaturated color; avoid speckles, spots, marble veining, cracks, wood grain, heavy reflections, shiny plastic, thick 3D edges or translucency. No cast shadow, extra objects, text, emblem, symbols, watermark, background or checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha only outside the opaque piece. Output one blank piece on square canvas with margins matching the edit target.
assets.visual_review: Blank opaque celadon porcelain; straight overhead pentagonal silhouette preserved; satin glaze; no wood grain, text or added shadow. Gote is visibly deeper blue-green than sente.
